## PyCon Ireland 2026

### Can Machine-Learning Models beat Classical Option Pricing?

**Upcoming talk**

Can physics-informed neural networks compete with classical
numerical methods? This talk presents my comparison of PINNs,
PIKANs and Crank–Nicolson for Black–Scholes option pricing,
covering accuracy, runtime and sensitivity to volatility.

[Related project](option-pricing.qmd)

## Irish Student Managed Fund

### Position Sizing and Risk Management for Systematic Trading

A recorded introductory lecture on sizing positions and
managing risk in systematic trading.

The lecture covers how position sizing affects portfolio
risk, with a Python example exploring volatility targeting,
turnover and drawdowns.

The accompanying notebook uses simulated returns as an
educational illustration.
